neighbours.label: The deferred, late moment: paying 'at the door' instead of in advance, and 'waiting until' a problem is bad instead of acting early
fire: Advance tickets cost $12, or $15 at the door.
Entry is $8 online and $10 at the door for adults.
Too many homeowners ignore a dripping pipe until the ceiling collapses.
Don't put off the vet visit until your dog stops eating.
Most drivers only check their tyres when one goes flat on the motorway.
It is better to save now than to wait until you retire with nothing.
Registration closes Friday, but late entrants can still pay at the door.
Students often leave revision until the night before the exam.
quiet: Advance tickets cost $12, or $20 for a pair.
Entry is $8 online and children enter free.
Too many homeowners ignore a dripping pipe in the basement.
Take your dog to the vet for a yearly check-up.
Most drivers check their tyres at the petrol station.
It is better to save a little every month for retirement.
Registration closes Friday, and the hall's main door faces the car park.
Students often revise in the library with their friends.
